The Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) has detected two cases of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) in Karnataka.  Both the cases were detected at Bengaluru's Baptist hospital.

The first one is a 3-month-old female infant while the second one is an 8-month-old male infant.
